package.limits: Full optimized suite and universal package on this host; not live desktop/physical tablet, physical Intel/macOS14/macOS26 or complete Photoshop equivalence.

api.existing_expansion: paint.stroke now automatically creates an ordinary pixel layer above a nonraster target for Brush; erasing still requires pixels.
api.state: Per-tool settings, Mixer reservoir/pickup/amount/sampled-tip dimensions, pattern IDs/phase and active gesture. Normal shared-document revision and busy/lifecycle guards apply.
api.target_limits: Color Replacement, Background Eraser and Magic Eraser require RGB pixels; all-layer sampling rejects grayscale targets. Other tools support masks and grayscale channels.
api.limits: API body4MiB;1–4096 samples, Magic Eraser exactly1;200000 generated dabs and134217728 raster visits; one footprint and Magic canvas at most16MP. Mixer sampled tip at most256x256.

adobe_api.status: No dedicated new freehand painting endpoint in pinned Photoshop v2 contract. Published execute-actions brush resources and tool/actionJSON descriptors remain unsupported; no compatibility claim or invented route. Existing conformance regressions run in the full suite.

menus.note: Existing factory tool entries now have actual implementations. Menu titles/order/shortcuts unchanged; these are tools, not invented menu commands.

limitations: Exact Photoshop pixels, linear/HDR paint/color semantics and proprietary Mixer wet-media/Impressionist algorithms remain unqualified.
Mixer physical bristle behavior and transferred wetness/mix jitter remain open. Current finite reservoir/pickup model is deterministic and bounded.

Background conversion uses the upstream name/position/transparency-lock representation, narrowed to an identity-transformed bottom root layer matching canvas bounds; dedicated native Background identity remains open.
New-tool Actions/Batch recording, tool-specific preset capture and Adobe brush-resource/actionJSON job compatibility remain open.
Complete live Photoshop UI/tablet comparison and physical Intel/macOS14/macOS26 qualification remain open.
High-resolution incremental preview/performance and secondary brush controls remain open; smaller fidelity details stay deferred while major workflows are missing.
actions: Prepared painting commands are explicit unsupported recorded steps in the existing Actions recorder. New-tool Actions playback/Batch coverage remains open; existing ordinary paint.stroke recording is preserved.
next: B08 Adjustment Brush: editable local adjustment layers/masks, additive/subtractive painting, object targeting, controls/history and shared API. Exact numeric and cosmetic polishing stays deferred.

development_audit.scope: Documentation/evidence inventory; not an independent Photoshop comparison.
